PROVISIONAL ADMISSION CERTIFICATE
Congratulations Abhishek M G !!
31-08-2026
We are pleased to inform you that your Provisional Admission has been completed. Below are the relevant details:
Institute
ACHARYA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
Program
Master of Computer Applications
Specialization
Master of Computer Application
Academic Year
2026-2027
Unique Identification (AUID) : Your AUID is AIT26MCAV029. Please ensure that you reference this AUID in all future 
communication and transactions with the institution.
Email Address : All students are assigned a dedicated college email address. You are encouraged to use this account as your 
primary means of receiving important information and communicating with the college. Your email will become active within 
2 working days  from the date of admission.
Email ID
abhishekg_26mcav@acharya.ac.in
Student ERP User ID
AIT26MCAV029
Passsword for Student Email and ERP Login
acharya1234
Parent ERP User ID
8431342419
ERP Web Access Link
https://www.acharyaerptech.in
The ERP provides you access to your programme details, information on your teachers, timetable, attendance, pay fee and 
most importantly connect with your Mentor. The information may be accessed on a web browser or by using the ERP App 
on your mobile phone. You may download the app using the QR codes below. The portal allows multiple logins, allowing 
parents to use the same to be updated on their ward's academic progress.
Counsellor Assistance: Should you require any further details or assistance, please feel free to contact Bindu L, your desig-
nated counsellor and they would be glad to help you navigate any queries or concerns.
Once again, congratulations on taking this important step in your academic journey. We look forward to welcoming you and 
wish you every success in your studies.
